productOnPage.title: Disney 5 Minute Stories Collection
productOnPage.author: Disney
productOnPage.description: Yoto Says: Join Mickey, Moana, Elsa and many more beloved Disney characters in this collection of 5-minute stories. Bring the magic of Disney to every moment of the day with the Disney 5 Minute Stories Collection. Bringing together five beloved 5-Minute Stories titles, it is packed with exciting adventures, empowering tales, and heartwarming bedtime moments featuring your favourite Disney characters. Join Anna and Elsa in Arendelle, set sail with Mickey and friends, celebrate inspiring princesses and fearless heroines, and wind down with soothing sleepy-time stories. Each story is perfectly sized for busy days, quick story breaks, and cosy bedtimes, delivering all the magic of Disney in just five minutes. With adventure, friendship, girl power, and dreamy bedtime tales, this collection is perfect for little Disney fans. Tracks included: Frozen The Ghost of Arendelle Snow and Tell Frozen 2

#### Who are Creators on Yoto?

Creators are independent audio makers bringing their original stories, games, songs and more to Yoto Cards. We hand-pick the best and freshest ideas — so every Creators Card meets the Yoto gold standard.

[Explore the Creators Collection](/creators/)

[Read Creator biographies](https://yoto.space/creator-profiles)
